name: Munaam Naveed
title: Leadership Education Specialist @ Troost ILead, University of Toronto Faculty of Applied Science & Engineering
bio: Munaam Naveed is the Leadership Education Specialist at Troost ILead, within the Faculty of Applied Science & Engineering at the University of Toronto. Munaam holds a Masters in Education in Student Development and Student Services in Higher Education from OISE, an Honours Bachelor of Arts in Sociology and CCIT from UofT, and a Certificate in Digital Communication from Sheridan College. As a lifelong learner, she recently completed her certificate in Leadership Essentials from UofT's School of Continuing Studies to better understand how to lead better and strategies she can share with others. Munaam has over seven years of experience working in various higher educational institutions in the GTA, where she focused on the professional and holistic development of students. Her experience spans across a number of functional areas including: career education, mentorship, residence life, orientation, leadership development, co-curricular instructional design, and CCR administration, with a keen focus on purposeful engagement of students. In all her roles, Munaam ensures to integrate equity and inclusiveness, while supporting students in better understanding and expressing the intersectional aspects of their identities.
